en.title: st
en.summary: This is the letter L340 from the alphabet vowel-consonant groups.

sections.title: The letters st
paragraphs: The letters st make two sounds in English. You hear their main sound at the start of (stop) /stɒp/, which means to halt. In some words the second letter is a silent letter, so you say only the first sound. A silent letter is a letter that you write but do not say.

sections.title: How to say it
paragraphs: First make a voiceless hiss. A voiceless sound is a sound where your vocal cords do not shake. Blow air past your tongue tip near the upper teeth. Then touch your tongue to the ridge behind your upper teeth and release the air. Put your hand on your throat to feel that your voice stays off. For the second sound, make only the hiss and do not touch the ridge.

sections.title: Spelling rules
paragraphs: You say both sounds at the start, in the middle, or at the end of most words. You hear this in (fast) /fɑːst/. The second letter is silent in certain words, especially before le or en. You hear this pattern in (castle) /kɑː.səl/ and in (listen) /lɪs.ən/.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs: Do not add an extra vowel sound before the start of this consonant cluster. A consonant cluster is two or more consonants side by side with no vowel between them. Start directly with the hissing sound, not with an extra sound before it. When the second letter is silent before le or en, do not try to say it.
